verdicts.why: Raina only goes through Terrigenesis in What They Become (S2#10); calling her Inhuman on the S2#9 card gives that away. In S2#9 Ward boards the Bus and takes Raina for Hydra.
Raina grabbing the Obelisk in the chaos of Hunter's shot at Creel happens in Heavy Is the Head (S2#2), not S2#9. The first sentence matches the Vancouver safehouse events of S2#9.
In What They Become Trip gets into the temple as it seals and kicks the Diviner off its pedestal to try to save Skye, and a shard of it turns him to stone. He never pulls her away.
Guarding Raina on the Bus around Vancouver is ...Ye Who Enter Here (S2#9). In S2#10 Trip gets into the sealed temple with Skye and Raina and dies kicking the Diviner.

In One of Us Mack keeps Hunter at a safe house, brings him pizza and a beer, they talk about the Dubai mission where they met Bobbi, and Mack blindfolds him for pickup by the real S.H.I.E.L.D. Hunter confronting Mack over the secrets is S2#12, and meeting Gonzales on the carrier is S2#14.
In Who You Really Are Sif teams up with Vin-Tak against Skye. Fitz knocks Vin-Tak down with the Destroyer gun and Bobbi wipes his memory with his own truncheon.

Gordon teleports Cal away just as he hands Angar the microphone, which is the capture itself; there is no later capture. Gordon then tells him he makes too much noise and is 'not one of us... just a science experiment'.

S2#15 shows the Iliad flashback (Bobbi helps save the wounded Gonzales and retake the ship instead of sinking it) and Bobbi stealing the toolbox and letting Gonzales' agents into the base. The decision to infiltrate and raid the base is made in S2#14.

The recruitment as a mercenary is S2#1, already stage 0. What happens between them in One Door Closes is the end tag where Hunter signs a napkin as his contract to become a permanent agent and help retake the Playground.
In Melinda Fitz opens the toolbox in a restroom, reaches Coulson and Hunter, and Hunter tells him how to shake the tail. Fitz only joins them in The Frenemy of My Enemy (S2#18).
In S2#17 May only finds that Coulson has been secretly meeting Garner; Coulson reveals that it was counseling about the alien writing in The Dirty Half Dozen (S2#19).
In S2#19 Fitz tells Mike that Hydra dismantled his leg and that they are sending him to a facility to be helped; no repair is shown. He broke free of Hydra in S1#22.
In Afterlife Skye asks if Lincoln lives there. He says nobody does and that he lives in Cincinnati, finishing med school.

In S2#19 Mike is a Hydra prisoner. May agrees to Coulson's plan and is on the team that storms List's base and frees him, after which he is sent off for repairs, so he does not work with the team here.

In Scars Bobbi stands up for Kara, and Kara, wearing May's face, ambushes her on the quinjet, saying she now remembers what happened between them; Ward then ICERs Bobbi. Nothing shows missions together, and Bobbi giving Kara up to Hydra is only told in S2#21.
That Bobbi's intel got Kara captured is first spelled out in S.O.S. Part One (S2#21), already stage 1. In S2#20 Kara only hints at an 'unspoken incident' before ambushing Bobbi for Ward.
Gonzales meets Jiaying and is killed at Afterlife. The Retreat is the safe house for powered people where Skye stays in S2#14-15. In Scars Skye is upset to see Gonzales instead of Coulson.

Coulson pinning Cal with the SUV and talking him down opens S.O.S. Part Two (S2#22). In Part One Coulson only questions Cal in his cell before the serum turns him and he attacks. Stage 3 is also at S2#22, so the owner may want to merge the two.

In S.O.S. Part One, at Afterlife, Raina tells a doubtful Skye that Jiaying is misleading the Inhumans, then provokes Jiaying into killing her so that Skye sees it. Her visions expose nothing to Skye; seeing her death does. The Retreat is a different, S.H.I.E.L.D. place.
Skye does not believe Raina's warning. What shows her the truth is seeing Jiaying kill Raina.

Under the rule that a stage must be something between the two, the S2#20 stage fails: in Scars Kara takes Bobbi with no Hunter scene. In S2#21 Hunter only sees the footage. They first face each other in the S2#22 firefight, which stage 2 already covers, so stage 1 goes.

In Many Heads, One Tale Garner's module is moved out of Endotex and Malick visits him alone, offering help in exchange for S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets. Ward only arrives later and gasses him to bring out Lash. Ward has no part in taking him from Endotex.

The opening 'After...' clause is earlier background and is true (Garner assesses Joey for Daisy's program in S3#2 and S3#7). Joey joining the Maveth mission that brings Coulson and Fitz back is what happens in S3#10. Coulson thought up the Secret Warriors, so the card line holds.
In Paradise Lost Coulson runs and draws Giyera into a locked, empty room where May is waiting, and she knocks him out. The lure is Coulson.

In The Team Yo-Yo's only scene with Simmons is giving her blood samples before demanding to leave. Fitz and Simmons assessing her is from the Slingshot web series, not the show, and she first came to S.H.I.E.L.D. earlier.

The S3#17 event, Fitz and Jemma finally becoming a couple, is stated correctly. The year apart and the Maveth rescue are framed as background ('After...', 'Once she is back'), not as events of this title, so no factual error is shown.

With the corrected S3#17 text, nothing between them there is friendly: Yo-Yo leaves S.H.I.E.L.D. angry and distrustful after the blood test. The friendship only shows in S5 (Jemma's surgery and care in S5#11-15), which stage 1 at S5#15 already marks as friend.
In Meet the New Boss Robbie, as Ghost Rider, saves Mack and Fitz from Frederick at Momentum Labs. Coulson and Mack investigating Canelo's while hunting Quake is The Ghost (S4#1).
In Deals with Our Devils the possessed Mack throws Zhi into a wall and kills him even after Robbie talks to him. Robbie then strikes a new deal and the Spirit leaves Mack.

Mace approves the strike team as Director and goes on the assault himself, and WP says he wants both Reyes and Daisy kept out of sight. 'Leads' vs 'joins' is a synonym swap with no clear factual error shown.

In Orientation Part One the man Mack knocks out is Virgil, whom he thinks is threatening Coulson. He is not a guard and has nothing to do with Enoch, so the only thing between Mack and Enoch is sending the team ahead.

In Inside Voices Fitz is already locked up and Mack, in charge, refuses to free him. Simmons fakes being poisoned so Mack lets Fitz out, and Yo-Yo uses her speed to lock Mack in the cell. Mack does not lock Fitz up.
In The Honeymoon Hale, arriving with Sleeper Mechs, shoots Deke in the shoulder as he moves to take Ruby's chakram. He is badly hurt.

In All Roads Lead... Hale surrenders as soon as Daisy and May raid the Academy, before Ruby is infused, and asks for help. Ruby loses control only later, at the facility, where Hale and Daisy try to calm her. Hale's plan to weaponize Daisy is S5#15.

In Option Two Talbot takes in the gravitonium and saves the agents, May among them, from the Remorath. In The One Who Will Save Us All he turns, knocks Daisy out and forces May to surrender aboard Qovas' ship.
